summary: OpenVideo v0.3.14 portable folder - unzip and double-click OpenVideo.cmd
notes: Unzip then double-click OpenVideo.cmd; Bootstrap auto-installs Node 22, Python 3.12, Git, FFmpeg, Whisper if missing.
No admin rights required; everything goes into %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenVideo\data\.
Bootstrap picks a free port (8787 if available, otherwise 8790-8889).
Colleague side-panel Download and Update button pulls this build on next launch.
Includes gateway + web build artifacts + jianying native writer; same tree as the developer main checkout.
